desc: Parse an amount like "$1,234.56" into cents. Format: an optional "-", then "$", then the dollars, then optionally a "." followed by exactly two digits of cents. The dollars are one or more decimal digits, either with no commas, or grouped as 1 to 3 digits followed by one or more groups of a comma and exactly 3 digits; ignoring commas, the dollars may not start with 0 unless they are exactly "0". Return dollars * 100 + cents, negated if there is a "-". Errors, checked in this order: "missing $" if the character after the optional "-" is not "$" (or there is none); "bad cents" if s contains a "." and the text after the first "." is not exactly two digits; "bad dollars" if the text between "$" and the first "." (or the end) is not valid dollars.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
